newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-POLAND'S JUSKOWIAK TO MISS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POLAND'S JUSKOWIAK TO MISS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Poland suffered a blow ahead of Wednesday's World Cup qualifier against Italy when defender Andrzej Juskowiak dropped out because of an ankle injury.
But captain Piotr Nowak and forward Marek Citko had recovered from injury and were expected to play in the group two match in Naples.
Nowak said on Monday Juskowiak's absence meant "the serious weakening of our team".
He added: "Our squad, however, is a cohesive group of players who know what the stakes are. Both at Wembley and at Chorzow we showed we know how to play."
Poland held group leaders Italy to a 0-0 draw at home earlier this month, and lost 2-1 away to England last year.
"We expect an offensive performance by Italy in Naples and that will give us a chance to spring our counter-attack on them," said Nowak.
